confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bolivian highland tourist pricing. Uyuni is a small town where prices are not directly verified, and the boliviano's parallel-market volatility adds uncertainty. Restaurant and budget-lodging anchors are roughly bounded; the 3-star hotel figure is least certain. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.4x beer, wine about 2x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. July high season for salt-flat tours may push tourist-facing prices toward the upper part of each range. FX observation came from search-result snippets attributed to rba.gov.au and was not confirmed by opening the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Bolivian highland tourist towns such as Potosi, Tupiza and Sucre, adjusted down for Uyuni's small size and tour-driven demand, with reference to budget Andean destinations such as Puno and smaller Peruvian towns.
